title: Differences in Behavior During Early Nectarine Infection Among Main Monilinia spp. Causing Brown Rot.
authors: Astacio, Juan Diego; Rodriguez-Pires, Silvia; Melgarejo, Paloma; De Cal, Antonieta; Espeso, Eduardo Antonio
one_liner_zh: 该文研究三种褐腐病菌在油桃早期侵染中的行为差异，涉及真菌转录因子调控和AlphaFold蛋白建模，但核心是植物病原真菌致病机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI/物理模拟方法用于结合建模。
abstract: Brown rot is a disease that affects stone and pome fruit crops worldwide. It is caused by fungal members of the genus Monilinia, mainly M. fructicola, M. laxa, and M. fructigena. This study presents evidence that, despite having a very similar battery of cell wall-degrading enzymes, the three species behave differently during the early stages of infection, suggesting differences at the regulatory level, which could also explain the differences in host preference among the three species. We have shown that M. fructicola infection is accelerated by red light, and the first symptoms appear much earlier than in darkness or in the other two species. The overexpression of genes encoding for CAZymes, such as pme3, pme2, pg1, cel1, pnl1, and pnl2, as well as the necrosis factor nep2, can be associated with the etiology of Monilinia spp. In addition, we found that nep2 in M. fructigena lacks binding sites in its promoter sequence for the white-collar complex, which is the major transcription factor responsible for regulating photoreception processes in fungi. Finally, we found that AlphaFold models of the NEP1-like proteins present on the three Monilinia species predict proteins with a very high degree of similarity.
abstract_zh: 褐腐病是一种影响全球核果和仁果类作物的病害，由Monilinia属真菌引起，主要包括M. fructicola、M. laxa和M. fructigena。本研究提供证据表明，尽管这三种真菌拥有非常相似的细胞壁降解酶组合，但在感染早期阶段它们的行为却有所不同，这暗示了调控水平上的差异，这也可能解释三种物种间寄主偏好的差异。我们已证明，红光加速了M. fructicola的感染，其首次症状出现的时间远早于黑暗条件下或其他两种物种。编码CAZymes（如pme3、pme2、pg1、cel1、pnl1和pnl2）以及坏死因子nep2的基因过表达，可能与Monilinia spp.的病因学相关。此外，我们发现M. fructigena中的nep2在其启动子序列中缺乏white-collar复合物的结合位点，该复合物是真菌中调控光感受过程的主要转录因子。最后，我们发现，对三种Monilinia物种中存在的NEP1样蛋白进行AlphaFold建模，预测出具有极高相似度的蛋白质。
